scan.description: Same target_box/sensor_model layout as 'baseline', plus test_spawn_delete_system creating and deleting a closer, occluding box within a single tick. If the map system ever left a zombie instance behind (see test_spawn_delete_system.cpp), it would occlude target_box and center_value would read ~0.75m instead of target_box's real ~2.5m.

points.description: Finite points should lie on target_box's front face, not the deleted flash box.
